proposed_comments.body:
### Clear the optional shortcut when its setting is absent

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `AdvancedPaste::read_settings` in `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/dllmain.cpp`.

**Problem:** After a shortcut has been configured, loading a legacy settings payload without `paste-as-single-line-hotkey` skips this assignment and retains the previous member value. The first-load default is empty, but it does not reset an already-running module.

**Why it matters:** The runner can re-register the old chord from `get_hotkeys` even though the current settings no longer contain that shortcut.

**Suggested change:** Clear the member when the optional property is absent; keep the guarded parse for older settings files.

```suggestion
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        m_paste_as_single_line_hotkey = {};
                    }
```

**Verification:** Configure a single-line shortcut, then reload a nonempty legacy properties payload without the new key. Confirm that `get_hotkeys` returns an empty single-line shortcut and the old chord is no longer registered.
proposed_comments.title: Clear the optional shortcut when its setting is absent

confidence.rationale: The absent-key branch leaves a persistent shortcut unchanged, and get_hotkeys returns that member during reconfiguration.

proposed_comments.body:
### Collapse Unicode horizontal spaces next to line breaks

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `SingleLineTextHelper.LineBreakRegex`.

**Problem:** Both horizontal-whitespace classes accept only ASCII space and tab. `First\u00A0\nSecond` therefore becomes `First\u00A0 Second`, and `First\n\u2003\nSecond` becomes `First \u2003 Second`, instead of collapsing the whitespace around the breaks to one space.

**Why it matters:** Text copied from documents can contain non-breaking or em spaces. The promised normalization does not hold for those inputs, although Unicode characters away from line breaks should remain unchanged.

**Suggested change:** Include Unicode space separators around line breaks while retaining inline characters and the non-backtracking regex.

```suggestion
        "[\\p{Zs}\\t]*(?:(?:\\r\\n|[\\n\\r\\u000B\\u000C\\u0085\\u2028\\u2029])[\\p{Zs}\\t]*)+",
```

Add regression cases for a non-breaking space before a break, an em space between repeated breaks, and unchanged inline Unicode spaces.

**Verification:** The first two inputs should produce `First Second`; `Keep\u00A0inline\u2003spaces` should be preserved.
proposed_comments.title: Collapse Unicode horizontal spaces next to line breaks

confidence.rationale: The ASCII-only character classes preserve non-breaking and em spaces next to breaks; Unicode space separators normalize these cases without changing inline text.

proposed_comments.body:
### Derive custom-action classification from the current accessor list

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `AdvancedPasteSettings.GetAllHotkeyAccessors` and `ShortcutConflictViewModel.GetHotkeyLocalizationHeader`.

**Problem:** The new fifth built-in shortcut shifts additional-action IDs, but the conflict dialog still treats every Advanced Paste ID greater than 9 as a custom action. With coaching disabled, Transcode to MP3 is now ID 10 and MP4 is ID 11, so the dialog returns raw `TranscodeToMp3` and `TranscodeToMp4` keys instead of their localized headers.

**Why it matters:** Users resolving a shortcut conflict see implementation keys for normal built-in actions rather than the names shown in Settings.

**Suggested change:** Derive the classification from the loaded settings instead of a fixed ID.

1. In `SetupModuleData`, when the settings are `AdvancedPasteSettings`, compute the first custom-action index as `allHotkeyAccessors.Length - advancedPasteSettings.Properties.CustomActions.Value.Count`. This includes the coaching accessor only when it is actually present.
2. Pass whether `module.HotkeyID` belongs to that custom-action tail into `GetHotkeyLocalizationHeader` rather than testing `hotkeyID > 9`.
3. Return the literal action name only for that custom tail; resolve the normal `/Header` resource for all built-in additional actions.

**Verification:** Check conflicts for MP3 and MP4 with coaching disabled and enabled. Both should use their localized `/Header` resources, while a named custom action should display its own name.
proposed_comments.title: Derive custom-action classification from the current accessor list

confidence.rationale: The accessor order places built-in MP3 and MP4 actions beyond the fixed custom-action boundary; the optional coaching accessor also changes that boundary.

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The new accessor is in the PR diff, but the required custom-action classification fix is in the unchanged ShortcutConflictViewModel.GetHotkeyLocalizationHeader method.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep hotkey string storage stable until telemetry is emitted

**Severity:** `medium`

**Affected code:** `Trace::AdvancedPaste_SettingsTelemetry` in `src/modules/AdvancedPaste/AdvancedPasteModuleInterface/trace.cpp`.

**Problem:** `getHotkeyCStr` appends a string to a vector and returns its `c_str()` pointer. Later appends, including the new fifth built-in field and additional-action fields, can reallocate the vector before TraceLogging consumes previously captured pointers. Short strings stored inside moved string objects are particularly susceptible.

**Why it matters:** With diagnostics and the provider enabled, the event can read invalid storage and report corrupted shortcut strings.

**Suggested change:** Stabilize the backing storage before any string pointer is captured.

1. Immediately after constructing `hotkeyStrs`, call `hotkeyStrs.reserve(5 + additionalActionsHotkeys.size());`, before calling either helper. Alternatively, use storage with stable addresses.
2. Keep the existing event fields and their order; ensure subsequent appends cannot exceed the reserved number of hotkey strings.

**Verification:** Emit settings telemetry with short unassigned shortcut strings and configured additional actions; confirm all shortcut fields remain correct across the entire event construction.
proposed_comments.title: Keep hotkey string storage stable until telemetry is emitted

confidence.rationale: Vector reallocation can invalidate captured short-string pointers before TraceLogging consumes the complete event arguments.

proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The added telemetry argument is in the PR diff, but the storage reservation must occur at the unchanged hotkeyStrs declaration before any string pointer is captured.
